issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify Animal.messageOnFeed() as returning String, but the solution's abstract Animal declares messageOnFeed() to return FeedResponse while some concrete classes (Pig/Seal) return FeedResponse and others (Goat) return String. This creates a return-type mismatch across artifacts and an internal inconsistency in the solution that would lead to compilation errors and confuse students about the expected return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type of messageOnFeed() consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) Update the problem statement/UML to specify a FeedResponse return type and ensure all concrete Animal subclasses return FeedResponse (and document FeedResponse in the spec); or (B) Change the solution so Animal.messageOnFeed() returns String and modify Pig and Seal to return String (remove usage of FeedResponse). Ensure Farm and other code that prints feed messages use the String return value (or call .toString() if FeedResponse is chosen).
